sections.label: A glorification of Prana, Breath or Vital Spirit
sections.name: Book 11, hymn 4

verses.sa:
प्राणाय नमो यस्य सर्वमिदं वशे ।
यो भूतः सर्वस्येश्वरो यस्मिन्त्सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
verses.tr: prāṇāya namo yasya sarvamidaṃ vaśe yo bhūtaḥ sarvasyeśvaro yasmintsarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.en: Homage to Prana, him who hath dominion o'er the universe, Who hath become the Sovran Lord of all, on whom the whole depends!

verses.sa:
नमस्ते प्राण क्रन्दाय नमस्ते स्तनयित्नवे ।
नमस्ते प्राण विद्युते नमस्ते प्राण वर्षते॥
verses.tr: namaste prāṇa krandāya namaste stanayitnave namaste prāṇa vidyute namaste prāṇa varṣate
verses.en: Homage, O Prana, to thy roar, to thunder-peal and lightning -flash! Homage, O Prana, unto thee what time thou sendesb down thy rain!

verses.sa:
यत् प्राण स्तनयित्नुनाभिक्रन्दत्योषधीः ।
प्र वीयन्ते गर्भान् दधतेऽथो बह्वीर्वि जायन्ते॥
verses.tr: yat prāṇa stanayitnunābhikrandatyoṣadhīḥ pra vīyante garbhān dadhate'tho bahvīrvi jāyante
verses.en: When Prans with a thunderous voice shouts his loud message to the plants, They straightway are impregnate, they conceive, and bear abundantly.

verses.sa:
यत् प्राण ऋतावागतेऽभिक्रन्दत्योषधीः ।
सर्वं तदा प्र मोदते यत् किं च भूम्यामधि॥
verses.tr: yat prāṇa ṛtāvāgate'bhikrandatyoṣadhīḥ sarvaṃ tadā pra modate yat kiṃ ca bhūmyāmadhi
verses.en: When the due season hath arrived and Prana shouteth to herbs, Then all is joyful, yea, each thing upon the surface of the earth.

verses.sa:
यदा प्राणो अभ्यवर्षीद् वर्षेण पृथिवीं महीम्।
पशवस्तत् प्र मोदन्ते महो वै नो भविष्यति॥
verses.tr: yadā prāṇo abhyavarṣīd varṣeṇa pṛthivīṃ mahīm paśavastat pra modante maho vai no bhaviṣyati
verses.en: When Prana hath poured down his flood of rain upon the mighty land, Cattle and beasts rejoice thereat: Now great will be our strength, they cry.

verses.sa:
अभिवृष्टा ओषधयः प्राणेन समवादिरन्।
आयुर्वै नः प्रातीतरः सर्वा नः सुरभीरकः॥
verses.tr: abhivṛṣṭā oṣadhayaḥ prāṇena samavādiran āyurvai naḥ prātītaraḥ sarvā naḥ surabhīrakaḥ
verses.en: Watered by Prana's rain the plants have raised their voices in accord: Thou hast prolonged our life, they say, and given fragrance to us all,

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अस्त्वायते नमो अस्तु परायते।
नमस्ते प्राण तिष्ठत आसीनायोत ते नमः॥
verses.tr: namaste astvāyate namo astu parāyate namaste prāṇa tiṣṭhata āsīnāyota te namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to thee when coming nigh, homage to thee departing hence I Homage, O Prana, be to thee when standing and when sitting still.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते प्राण प्राणते नमो अस्त्वपानते।
पराचीनाय ते नमः प्रतीचीनाय ते नमः सर्वस्मै त इदं नमः॥
verses.tr: namaste prāṇa prāṇate namo astvapānate parācīnāya te namaḥ pratīcīnāya te namaḥ sarvasmai ta idaṃ namaḥ
verses.en: Homage to thee at every breath thou drawest in and sendest forth! Homage to thee when turned away, homage to thee seen face to face! This reverence be to all of thee!

verses.sa:
या ते प्राण प्रिया तनूर्यो ते प्राण प्रेयसी ।
अथो यद् भेषजं तव तस्य नो धेहि जीवसे॥
verses.tr: yā te prāṇa priyā tanūryo te prāṇa preyasī atho yad bheṣajaṃ tava tasya no dhehi jīvase
verses.en: Prana, communicate to us thy dear, thy very dearest form, Whatever healing balm thou hast, give us thereof that we may live,

verses.sa:
प्राणः प्रजा अनु वस्ते पिता पुत्रमिव प्रियम्।
प्राणो ह सर्वस्येश्वरो यच्च प्राणति यच्च न॥
verses.tr: prāṇaḥ prajā anu vaste pitā putramiva priyam prāṇo ha sarvasyeśvaro yacca prāṇati yacca na
verses.en: Prana robes living creatures as a father his beloved son. Prana is sovran Lord of all, of all that breathes not, all that breathes,

verses.sa:
प्राणो मृत्युः प्राणस्तक्मा प्राणं देवा उपासते ।
प्राणो ह सत्यवादिनमुत्तमे लोक आ दधत्॥
verses.tr: prāṇo mṛtyuḥ prāṇastakmā prāṇaṃ devā upāsate prāṇo ha satyavādinamuttame loka ā dadhat
verses.en: I Prana is Fever, he is Death. Prana is worshipped by the Gods. Prana sets in the loftiest sphere the man who speaks the words of truth.

verses.sa:
प्राणो विराट् प्राणो देष्ट्री प्राणं सर्व उपासते ।
प्राणो ह सूर्यश्चन्द्रमाः प्राणमाहुः प्रजापतिम्॥
verses.tr: prāṇo virāṭ prāṇo deṣṭrī prāṇaṃ sarva upāsate prāṇo ha sūryaścandramāḥ prāṇamāhuḥ prajāpatim
verses.en: Prana is Deshtri, and Viraj Prana is reverenced by all. He is the Sun, he is the Moon. Prana is called Prajapati. s

verses.sa:
प्राणापानौ व्रीहियवावनड्वान् प्राण उच्यते ।
यवे ह प्राण आहितोऽपानो व्रीहिरुच्यते॥
verses.tr: prāṇāpānau vrīhiyavāvanaḍvān prāṇa ucyate yave ha prāṇa āhito'pāno vrīhirucyate
verses.en: Both breaths are rice and barley, and Prana is called the toiling ox: i In barley is the inbreath laid, and rice is named the outward breath,

verses.sa:
अपानति प्राणति पुरुषो गर्भे अन्तरा।
यदा त्वं प्राण जिन्वस्यथ स जायते पुनः॥
verses.tr: apānati prāṇati puruṣo garbhe antarā yadā tvaṃ prāṇa jinvasyatha sa jāyate punaḥ
verses.en: The human infant in the womb draws vital breath and sends it out: When thou, O Prana, quickenest the babe it springs anew to life,

verses.sa:
प्राणमाहुर्मातरिश्वानं वातो ह प्राण उच्यते ।
प्राणे ह भूतं भव्यं च प्राणे सर्वं प्रतिष्ठितम्॥
verses.tr: prāṇamāhurmātariśvānaṃ vāto ha prāṇa ucyate prāṇe ha bhūtaṃ bhavyaṃ ca prāṇe sarvaṃ pratiṣṭhitam
verses.en: The name of Prana is bestowed on Matarisvan and on Wind, On Prana, past and future, yea, on Prana everything depends.

verses.sa:
आथर्वणीराङ्गिरसीर्दैवीर्मनुष्यजा उत।
ओषधयः प्र जायन्ते यदा त्वं प्राण जिन्वसि॥
verses.tr: ātharvaṇīrāṅgirasīrdaivīrmanuṣyajā uta oṣadhayaḥ pra jāyante yadā tvaṃ prāṇa jinvasi
verses.en: All herbs and plants spring forth and grow when thou, O Prana, quickenest, Plants of Atharvan, Angiras, plants of the deities and men,

verses.sa:
यदा प्राणो अभ्यवर्षीद् वर्षेण पृथिवीं महीम्।
ओषधयः प्र जायन्तेऽथो याः काश्च वीरुधः॥
verses.tr: yadā prāṇo abhyavarṣīd varṣeṇa pṛthivīṃ mahīm oṣadhayaḥ pra jāyante'tho yāḥ kāśca vīrudhaḥ
verses.en: When Prana hath poured down his flood of rain upon the mighty earth, The plants are wakened into life, and every herb that grows on ground,

verses.sa:
यस्ते प्राणेदं वेद यस्मिंश्चासि प्रतिष्ठितः ।
सर्वे तस्मै बलिं हरानमुष्मिंल्लोक उत्तमे॥
verses.tr: yaste prāṇedaṃ veda yasmiṃścāsi pratiṣṭhitaḥ sarve tasmai baliṃ harānamuṣmiṃlloka uttame
verses.en: The man who knows this truth of thee, O. Prana, and what bears thee up—To him will all present their gift of tribute in that loftiest will all present their gift of tribute in that loftiest world,

verses.sa:
यथा प्राण बलिहृतस्तुभ्यं सर्वाः प्रजा इमाः ।
एवा तस्मै बलिं हरान् यस्त्वा शृणवत् सुश्रवः॥
verses.tr: yathā prāṇa balihṛtastubhyaṃ sarvāḥ prajā imāḥ evā tasmai baliṃ harān yastvā śṛṇavat suśravaḥ
verses.en: As all these living creatures are thy tributaries, Prana, so Shall they bring tribute unto him who hears thee with attentive ears.

verses.sa:
अन्तर्गर्भश्चरति देवतास्वाभूतो भूतः स उ जायते पुनः ।
स भूतो भव्यं भविष्यत् पिता पुत्रं प्र विवेशा शचीभिः॥
verses.tr: antargarbhaścarati devatāsvābhūto bhūtaḥ sa u jāyate punaḥ sa bhūto bhavyaṃ bhaviṣyat pitā putraṃ pra viveśā śacībhiḥ
verses.en: Filled with a babe, mid deities he wanders: grown, near at hand, he springs again to being, That Father, grown the present and the future, hath past into the son with mighty powers,

verses.sa:
एकं पादं नोत्खिदति सलिलाद्धंस उच्चरन्।
यदङ्ग स तमुत्खिदेन्नैवाद्य न श्वः स्यान्न रात्री नाहः स्यान्न व्युऽछेत् कदा चन॥
verses.tr: ekaṃ pādaṃ notkhidati salilāddhaṃsa uccaran yadaṅga sa tamutkhidennaivādya na śvaḥ syānna rātrī nāhaḥ syānna vyu'chet kadā cana
verses.en: Hansa, what time he rises up, leaves in the flood one foot unmoved, i If he withdrew it there would be no more to-morrow or to-day, l Never would there be night, no more would daylight shine or morning flush.

verses.sa:
अष्टाचक्रं वर्तत एकनेमि सहस्राक्षरं प्र पुरो नि पश्चा।
अर्धेन विश्वं भुवनं जजान यदस्यार्धं कतमः स केतुः॥
verses.tr: aṣṭācakraṃ vartata ekanemi sahasrākṣaraṃ pra puro ni paścā ardhena viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna yadasyārdhaṃ katamaḥ sa ketuḥ
verses.en: It rolleth on, eight-wheeled and single-fellied, and with a thousand eyes, forward and backward, With one half it engendered all creation. What sign is there to tell us of the other?

verses.sa:
यो अस्य विश्वजन्मन ईशे विश्वस्य चेष्टतः ।
अन्येषु क्षिप्रधन्वने तस्मै प्राण नमोऽस्तु ते॥
verses.tr: yo asya viśvajanmana īśe viśvasya ceṣṭataḥ anyeṣu kṣipradhanvane tasmai prāṇa namo'stu te
verses.en: Homage, O Prana, unto thee armed with swift bow among the rest, In whose dominion is this All of varied sort that stirs and works! I

verses.sa:
यो अस्य सर्वजन्मन ईशे सर्वस्य चेष्टतः ।
अतन्द्रो ब्रह्मणा धीरः प्राणो मानु तिष्ठातु॥
verses.tr: yo asya sarvajanmana īśe sarvasya ceṣṭataḥ atandro brahmaṇā dhīraḥ prāṇo mānu tiṣṭhātu
verses.en: May he who rules this Universe of varied sort, that stirs and works, Prana, alert and resolute, assist me through the prayer I pray.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वः सुप्तेषु जागार ननु तिर्यङ् नि पद्यते ।
न सुप्तमस्य सुप्तेष्वनु शुश्राव कश्चन॥
verses.tr: ūrdhvaḥ supteṣu jāgāra nanu tiryaṅ ni padyate na suptamasya supteṣvanu śuśrāva kaścana
verses.en: Erect among the sleepers he wakes, and is never laid. at length, No one hath ever heard that he hath been asleep while others slept.

verses.sa:
प्राण मा मत् पर्यावृतो न मदन्यो भविष्यसि ।
अपां गर्भमिव जीवसे प्राण बध्नामि त्वा मयि॥
verses.tr: prāṇa mā mat paryāvṛto na madanyo bhaviṣyasi apāṃ garbhamiva jīvase prāṇa badhnāmi tvā mayi
verses.en: Thou, Prana, never shalt be hid, never shalt be estranged from me. I bind thee on myself for life, O Prana, like the Waters' germ.

sections.label: A glorification of the Brahmachari or religious student
sections.name: Book 11, hymn 5

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारीष्णंश्चरति रोदसी उभे तस्मिन् देवाः संमनसो भवन्ति ।
स दाधार पृथिवीं दिवं च स आचार्यं१ तपसा पिपर्ति॥
verses.tr: brahmacārīṣṇaṃścarati rodasī ubhe tasmin devāḥ saṃmanaso bhavanti sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ divaṃ ca sa ācāryaṃ1 tapasā piparti
verses.en: Stirring both worlds the Brahmachari moveth: in him the deities are all one-minded, He hath established firmly earth and heaven: he satisfies his Master with his Fervour,

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारिणं पितरो देवजनाः पृथग् देवा अनुसंयन्ति सर्वे ।
गन्धर्वा एनमन्वायन् त्रयस्त्रिंशत् त्रिशताः षट्सहस्राः सर्वान्त्स देवांस्तपसा पिपर्ति॥
verses.tr: brahmacāriṇaṃ pitaro devajanāḥ pṛthag devā anusaṃyanti sarve gandharvā enamanvāyan trayastriṃśat triśatāḥ ṣaṭsahasrāḥ sarvāntsa devāṃstapasā piparti
verses.en: After the Brahmachari go the Fathers, the heavenly hosts, all Gods in separate order, After him too have the Gandharvas followed, thirty and three, three hundred, and six thousand, He satisfies all Gods with his devotion.

verses.sa:
आचार्यऽ उपनयमानो ब्रह्मचारिणं कृणुते गर्भमन्तः ।
तं रात्रीस्तिस्र उदरे बिभर्ति तं जातं द्रष्टुमभिसंयन्ति देवाः॥
verses.tr: ācārya' upanayamāno brahmacāriṇaṃ kṛṇute garbhamantaḥ taṃ rātrīstisra udare bibharti taṃ jātaṃ draṣṭumabhisaṃyanti devāḥ
verses.en: The Master, welcoming his new disciple, into his bowels takes the Brahmachari, Three nights he holds and bears him in his belly. When he is born, the Gods convene to see him.

verses.sa:
इयं समित् पृथिवी द्यौर्द्वितीयोतान्तरिक्षं समिधा पृणाति ।
ब्रह्मचारी समिधा मेखलया श्रमेण लोकांस्तपसा पिपर्ति॥
verses.tr: iyaṃ samit pṛthivī dyaurdvitīyotāntarikṣaṃ samidhā pṛṇāti brahmacārī samidhā mekhalayā śrameṇa lokāṃstapasā piparti
verses.en: This log is earth, the second log is heaven: he fills the air's mid region with the fuel. With fuel, with his zone the Brahmachari contents the worlds, with labour and with Fervour.

verses.sa:
पूर्वो जातो ब्रह्मणो ब्रह्मचारी घर्मं वसानस्तपसोदतिष्ठत्।
तस्माज्जातं ब्राह्मणं ब्रह्म ज्येष्ठं देवाश्च सर्वे अमृतेन साकम्॥
verses.tr: pūrvo jāto brahmaṇo brahmacārī gharmaṃ vasānastapasodatiṣṭhat tasmājjātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brahma jyeṣṭhaṃ devāśca sarve amṛtena sākam
verses.en: The Brahmachari, earlier born than Brahma, sprang up through Fervour, robed in hot libation, From him sprang heavenly lore, the highest Brahma, and all the Gods, with life that lasts for ever.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचार्येऽति समिधा समिद्धः कार्ष्णं वसानो दीक्षितो दीर्घश्मश्रुः ।
स सद्य एति पूर्वस्मादुत्तरं समुद्रं लोकान्त्संगृभ्य मुहुराचरिक्रत्॥
verses.tr: brahmacārye'ti samidhā samiddhaḥ kārṣṇaṃ vasāno dīkṣito dīrghaśmaśruḥ sa sadya eti pūrvasmāduttaraṃ samudraṃ lokāntsaṃgṛbhya muhurācarikrat
verses.en: Lighted by fuel goes the Brahmachari, clad in black-buck skin, consecrate, long-bearded. Swiftly he goes from east to northern ocean, grasping the worlds, oft bringing them anear him.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारी जनयन् ब्रह्मापो लोकं प्रजापतिं परमेष्ठिनं विराजम्।
गर्भो भूत्वामृतस्य योनाविन्द्रो ह भूत्वासुरांस्ततर्ह॥
verses.tr: brahmacārī janayan brahmāpo lokaṃ prajāpatiṃ parameṣṭhinaṃ virājam garbho bhūtvāmṛtasya yonāvindro ha bhūtvāsurāṃstatarha
verses.en: The Brahmachari, fathering Prayer, world, Waters, Viraj, Prajapati, and Parameshthin, Lay asa germ within the Immortal's bosom, then became Indra and destroyed the demons,

verses.sa:
आचार्यऽ स्ततक्ष नभसी उभे इमे उर्वी गम्भीरे पृथिवीं दिवं च ।
ते रक्षति तपसा ब्रह्मचारी तस्मिन् देवाः संमनसो भवन्ति॥
verses.tr: ācārya' statakṣa nabhasī ubhe ime urvī gambhīre pṛthivīṃ divaṃ ca te rakṣati tapasā brahmacārī tasmin devāḥ saṃmanaso bhavanti
verses.en: The Master fashioned both these cloudy regions, profound and spacious pair, the earth and heaven. The Brahmachari guards them with his Fervour. In him the deities are all one-minded,

verses.sa:
इमां भूमिं पृथिवीं ब्रह्मचारी भिक्षामा जभार प्रथमो दिवं च ।
ते कृत्वा समिधावुपास्ते तयोरार्पिता भुवनानि विश्वा॥
verses.tr: imāṃ bhūmiṃ pṛthivīṃ brahmacārī bhikṣāmā jabhāra prathamo divaṃ ca te kṛtvā samidhāvupāste tayorārpitā bhuvanāni viśvā
verses.en: The Brahmachari first of all brought hither this. ample earth as alms, and heaven above it. He makes these twain two fuel-logs, and worships, On these supported rest all living creatures.

verses.sa:
अर्वागन्यः परो अन्यो दिवस्पृष्ठाद् गुहा निधी निहितौ ब्राह्मणस्य ।
तौ रक्षति तपसा ब्रह्मचारी तत् केवलं कृणुते ब्रह्म विद्वान्॥
verses.tr: arvāganyaḥ paro anyo divaspṛṣṭhād guhā nidhī nihitau brāhmaṇasya tau rakṣati tapasā brahmacārī tat kevalaṃ kṛṇute brahma vidvān
verses.en: Both treasuries of sacred lore lie hidden, one hitherward, beyond heaven's ridge the other. The Brahmachari with his Fervour guards them, He makes this all his own as knowing Brahma,

verses.sa:
अर्वागन्य इतो अन्यः पृथिव्या अग्नी समेतो नभसी अन्तरमे।
तयोः श्रयन्ते रश्मयोऽधि दृढास्ताना तिष्ठति तपसा ब्रह्मचारी॥
verses.tr: arvāganya ito anyaḥ pṛthivyā agnī sameto nabhasī antarame tayoḥ śrayante raśmayo'dhi dṛḍhāstānā tiṣṭhati tapasā brahmacārī
verses.en: Hitherward one, hence from the earth the other, two Agnis meet between these cloudy regions. Close to these two firm rays of light are clinging, The Brahmachari enters them through Fervour,

verses.sa:
अभिक्रन्दन् स्तनयन्नरुणः शितिङ्गो बृहच्छेपोऽनु भूमौ जभार ।
ब्रह्मचारी सिञ्चति सानौ रेतः पृथिव्यां तेन जीवन्ति प्रदिशश्चतस्रः॥
verses.tr: abhikrandan stanayannaruṇaḥ śitiṅgo bṛhacchepo'nu bhūmau jabhāra brahmacārī siñcati sānau retaḥ pṛthivyāṃ tena jīvanti pradiśaścatasraḥ
verses.en: Thundering, shouting. ruddy-hued, and pallid, he bears along the earth great manly vigour, Down on the ridge of earth the Brahmachari pours seed, and this gives life to heaven's four regions.

verses.sa:
अग्नौ सूर्ये चन्द्रमसि मातरिश्वन् ब्रह्मचार्य१प्सु समिधमा दधाति ।
तासामर्चींषि पृथगभ्रे चरन्ति तासामाज्यं पुरुषो वर्षमापः॥
verses.tr: agnau sūrye candramasi mātariśvan brahmacārya1psu samidhamā dadhāti tāsāmarcīṃṣi pṛthagabhre caranti tāsāmājyaṃ puruṣo varṣamāpaḥ
verses.en: The Brahmachari stores with fuel Waters, and Fire, and Sun, and Moon, and Matarisvan, The Water's lights move separate in the rain-cloud, Man, rain, and water are their molten butter.

verses.sa:
आचार्योऽ मृत्युर्वरुणः सोम ओषधयः पयः ।
जीभूता आसन्त्सत्वानस्तैरिदं स्व१राभृतम्॥
verses.tr: ācāryo' mṛtyurvaruṇaḥ soma oṣadhayaḥ payaḥ jībhūtā āsantsatvānastairidaṃ sva1rābhṛtam
verses.en: The Master is Death, Varuna, Soma, the plants of i earth, and milk. The thunder-clouds were men of war. By these this heavenly light was brought.

verses.sa:
अमा घृतं कृणुते केवलमाचार्यो भूत्वा वरुणो यद्यदैच्छत् प्रजापतौ ।
तद् ब्रह्मचारी प्रायच्छत् स्वन् मित्रो अध्यात्मनः॥
verses.tr: amā ghṛtaṃ kṛṇute kevalamācāryo bhūtvā varuṇo yadyadaicchat prajāpatau tad brahmacārī prāyacchat svan mitro adhyātmanaḥ
verses.en: Varuna, made a Master, takes at home the butter to himself. Whatever with Prajapati he sought, the Brahmachari gave like Mitra from his loftiest soul.

verses.sa:
आचार्योऽ ब्रह्मचारी ब्रह्मचरी प्रजापतिः ।
प्रजापतिर्वि राजति विराडिन्द्रोऽभवद् वशी॥
verses.tr: ācāryo' brahmacārī brahmacarī prajāpatiḥ prajāpatirvi rājati virāḍindro'bhavad vaśī
verses.en: The pupil is the Master, yea, the pupil is. Prajapati. Prajapati shines bright; the bright Viraj grew potent Indra's self,

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचर्येण तपसा राजा राष्ट्रं वि रक्षति ।
आचार्योऽ ब्रह्मचर्येण ब्रह्मचारिणमिच्छते॥
verses.tr: brahmacaryeṇa tapasā rājā rāṣṭraṃ vi rakṣati ācāryo' brahmacaryeṇa brahmacāriṇamicchate
verses.en: By Fervour and by self-restraint the King protects the realm he "rules, By self-restraint the Master seeks a Brahmachari to instruct,

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचर्येण कन्या३ युवानं विन्दते पतिम्।
अनड्वान् ब्रह्मचर्येणाश्वो घासं जिगीर्षति॥
verses.tr: brahmacaryeṇa kanyā3 yuvānaṃ vindate patim anaḍvān brahmacaryeṇāśvo ghāsaṃ jigīrṣati
verses.en: By self-restraint a maiden finds a youth to be her wedded lord. By self-restraint the ox and horse seek to win fodder for themselves,

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचर्येण तपसा देवा मृत्युमपाघ्नत ।
इन्द्रो ह ब्रह्मचर्येण देवेभ्यः स्व१राभरत्॥
verses.tr: brahmacaryeṇa tapasā devā mṛtyumapāghnata indro ha brahmacaryeṇa devebhyaḥ sva1rābharat
verses.en: By Fervour and by self-restraint the Gods drave Death away from them, And Indra brought by self-restraint heaven's lustre to the deities,

verses.sa:
ओषधयो भूतभव्यमहोरात्रे वनस्पतिः ।
संवत्सरः सहर्तुभिस्ते जाता ब्रह्मचारिणः॥
verses.tr: oṣadhayo bhūtabhavyamahorātre vanaspatiḥ saṃvatsaraḥ sahartubhiste jātā brahmacāriṇaḥ
verses.en: The plants, what is and what shall be, day, night, the tall tree of the wood, The year with seasons ofthe year, all from the Brahmachari sprang.

verses.sa:
पार्थिवा दिव्याः पशव आरण्या ग्राम्याश्च ये।
अपक्षाः पक्षिणश्च ये ते जाता ब्रह्मचारिणः॥
verses.tr: pārthivā divyāḥ paśava āraṇyā grāmyāśca ye apakṣāḥ pakṣiṇaśca ye te jātā brahmacāriṇaḥ
verses.en: All creatures of the earth and heaven, tame animals and sylvan beasts, Winged and wingless c reatures, from the Brahmachari sprang to life.

verses.sa:
पृथक् सर्वे प्राजापत्याः प्राणानात्मसु बिभ्रति ।
तान्त्सर्वान् ब्रह्म रक्षति ब्रह्मचारिण्याभृतम्॥
verses.tr: pṛthak sarve prājāpatyāḥ prāṇānātmasu bibhrati tāntsarvān brahma rakṣati brahmacāriṇyābhṛtam
verses.en: All children of Prajapati have breath distinctly in themselves. The Brahma that is stored within the Brahmachari guards them all.

verses.sa:
देवानामेतत् परिषूतमनभ्यारूढं चरति रोचमानम्।
तस्माज्जातं ब्राह्मणं ब्रह्म ज्येष्ठं देवाश्च सर्वे अमतेन साकम्॥
verses.tr: devānāmetat pariṣūtamanabhyārūḍhaṃ carati rocamānam tasmājjātaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ brahma jyeṣṭhaṃ devāśca sarve amatena sākam
verses.en: Piled up on high, but never yet ascended, that power of deities is brightly shining. From that sprang heavenly lore, the loftiest Brahma, and all the Gods with life that lasts for ever.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मचारी ब्रह्म भ्राजद् बिभर्ति तस्मिन् देवा अधि विश्वे समोताः ।
प्राणापानौ जनयन्नाद् व्यानं वाचं मनो हृदयं ब्रह्म मेधाम्॥
verses.tr: brahmacārī brahma bhrājad bibharti tasmin devā adhi viśve samotāḥ prāṇāpānau janayannād vyānaṃ vācaṃ mano hṛdayaṃ brahma medhām
verses.en: The Brahmachari wields the radiant Brahma wherein all Gods are woven close together; Creating breath, inhaling and exhaling, voice, mind, and heart, Brahma and holy wisdom,

verses.sa: चक्षुः श्रोत्रं यशो अस्मासु धेह्यन्नं रेतो लोहितमुदरम्॥
verses.tr: cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ yaśo asmāsu dhehyannaṃ reto lohitamudaram
verses.en: Bestow on us the power of sight and hearing, glory and food and seed and blood and belly.

verses.sa:
तानि कल्पद् ब्रह्मचारी सलिलस्य पृष्ठे तपोऽतिष्ठत् तप्यमानः समुद्रे।
स स्नातो बभ्रुः पिङ्गलः पृथिव्यां बहु रोचते॥
verses.tr: tāni kalpad brahmacārī salilasya pṛṣṭhe tapo'tiṣṭhat tapyamānaḥ samudre sa snāto babhruḥ piṅgalaḥ pṛthivyāṃ bahu rocate
verses.en: These, standing on the flood, the Brahmachari formed practising in sea his hot devotion. When he hath bathed, brown, yellow-hued, he shines exceedingly on earth.

sections.label: A prayer to all Divinities and Sanctified for deliverance from distress
sections.name: Book 11, hymn 6

verses.sa:
अग्निं ब्रूमो वनस्पतीनोषधीरुत वीरुधः ।
इन्द्रं बृहस्पतिं सूर्यं ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: agniṃ brūmo vanaspatīnoṣadhīruta vīrudhaḥ indraṃ bṛhaspatiṃ sūryaṃ te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: We call on Agni, on the trees lords of the forest, herbs and plants, Indra, Surya, Brihaspati: may they deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
ब्रूमो राजानं वरुणं मित्रं विष्णुमथो भगम्।
अंशं विवस्वन्तं ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: brūmo rājānaṃ varuṇaṃ mitraṃ viṣṇumatho bhagam aṃśaṃ vivasvantaṃ brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: We call on Vishnu, Bhaga, on Mitra and Varuna the King, Ansa, Vivasvan we address: may they deliver us from woe,

verses.sa:
ब्रूमो देवं सवितारं धातारमुत पूषणम्।
त्वष्टारमग्रियं ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: brūmo devaṃ savitāraṃ dhātāramuta pūṣaṇam tvaṣṭāramagriyaṃ brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: We call on Savitar the God, on Pushan the establisher Tvashtar the foremost we address: may they deliver us from woe,

verses.sa:
गन्धर्वाप्सरसो ब्रूमो अश्विना ब्रह्मणस्पतिम्।
अर्यमा नाम यो देवस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: gandharvāpsaraso brūmo aśvinā brahmaṇaspatim aryamā nāma yo devaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Gandharvas and Apsarases, the Asvins, Brahmanaspati Aryaman, God, by name we call: may they deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
अहोरात्रे इदं ब्रूमः सूर्याचन्द्रमसावुभा।
विश्वानादित्यान् ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: ahorātre idaṃ brūmaḥ sūryācandramasāvubhā viśvānādityān brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: This word of ours to Day and Night, and to the Sun and Moon we speak, All the Adityas we address; may they deliver us from woe. Vata,

verses.sa:
वातं ब्रूमः पर्जन्यमन्तरिक्षमथो दिशः ।
आशाश्च सर्वा ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: vātaṃ brūmaḥ parjanyamantarikṣamatho diśaḥ āśāśca sarvā brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Parjanya we address, the Quarters, and the Firmament, And all the Regions of the' sky: may they deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
मुञ्चन्तु मा शपथ्याऽदहोरात्रे अथो उषाः ।
सोमो मा देवो मुञ्चतु यमाहुश्चन्द्रमा इति॥
verses.tr: muñcantu mā śapathyā'dahorātre atho uṣāḥ somo mā devo muñcatu yamāhuścandramā iti
verses.en: From all that brings a curse may Day and Night and Dawn deliver me, May Soma free me, God to whom they give the name of Chandramas.

verses.sa:
पार्थिवा दिव्यः पशव आरण्या उत ये मृगाः ।
शकुन्तान् पक्षिणो ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: pārthivā divyaḥ paśava āraṇyā uta ye mṛgāḥ śakuntān pakṣiṇo brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: All creatures both of heaven and earth, wild beasts and sylvan animals, And winged birds of air we call: may they deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
भवाशर्वाविदं ब्रूमो रुद्रं पशुपतिश्च यः ।
इषूर्या एषां संविद्म ता नः सन्तु सदा शिवाः॥
verses.tr: bhavāśarvāvidaṃ brūmo rudraṃ paśupatiśca yaḥ iṣūryā eṣāṃ saṃvidma tā naḥ santu sadā śivāḥ
verses.en: Bhava and Sarva we address, and Rudra who is Lord of Beasts, Their arrows which we feel and know: may they be ever kind to us,

verses.sa:
दिवं ब्रूमो नक्षत्राणि भूमिं यक्षाणि पर्वतान्।
समुद्रा नद्योऽ वेशन्तास्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: divaṃ brūmo nakṣatrāṇi bhūmiṃ yakṣāṇi parvatān samudrā nadyo' veśantāste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: We speak to Constellations, Heaven, to Earth, to Genii, and to Hills, To Seas, to Rivers, and to Lakes: may they deliver li us from woe,

verses.sa:
सप्तर्षीन् वा इदं ब्रूमोऽपो देवीः प्रजापतिम्।
पितॄन् यमश्रेष्ठान् ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: saptarṣīn vā idaṃ brūmo'po devīḥ prajāpatim pitṝn yamaśreṣṭhān brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Or the Seven Rishis we address, Waters divine, Prajapati, leathers with Yama at their head; may they deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
ये देवा दिविषदो अन्तरिक्षसदश्च ये।
पृथिव्यां शक्रा ये श्रितास्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: ye devā diviṣado antarikṣasadaśca ye pṛthivyāṃ śakrā ye śritāste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Gogs whose abode is in the heaven and those who dwell in middle air, And Mighty Ones who rest on earth: may they deliver us from woe,

verses.sa:
आदित्या रुद्रा वसवो दिवि देवा अथर्वाणः।
अङ्गिरसो मनीषिणस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: ādityā rudrā vasavo divi devā atharvāṇaḥ aṅgiraso manīṣiṇaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, Gods aloft in heaven, Atharvan's sons, The sages, sons of Angiras: may they deliver us from woe. M

verses.sa:
यज्ञं ब्रूमो यजमानमृचः सामानि भेषजा।
यजूंषि होत्रा ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: yajñaṃ brūmo yajamānamṛcaḥ sāmāni bheṣajā yajūṃṣi hotrā brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: To sacrifice, to worshipper, hymns, 'songs, and healing charms, we speak, To priestly acts- aud Yajus texts: may they deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
पञ्च राज्यानि वीरुधां सोमश्रेष्ठानि ब्रूमः ।
दर्भो भङ्गो यवः सहस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: pañca rājyāni vīrudhāṃ somaśreṣṭhāni brūmaḥ darbho bhaṅgo yavaḥ sahaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: To the five kingdoms of the plants which Soma rules as Lord we speak: Darbha, hemp, barley, mighty power: may these deliver us from woe,

verses.sa:
अरायान् ब्रूमो रक्षांसि सर्पान् पुण्यजनान् पितृन्।
मृत्यूनेकशतं ब्रूमस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: arāyān brūmo rakṣāṃsi sarpān puṇyajanān pitṛn mṛtyūnekaśataṃ brūmaste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: To demons and' fierce fiends we speak, to- Holy Genii, Fathers, Snakes, And to the hundred deaths and one: may. these deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
ऋतून् ब्रूम ऋतुपतीनार्तवानुत हायनान्।
समाः संवत्सरान् मासांस्ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: ṛtūn brūma ṛtupatīnārtavānuta hāyanān samāḥ saṃvatsarān māsāṃste no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: We speak to Seasons, Season-lords, to years and sections of the year, To Months, half-months, and years complete: may they deliver us from woe,

verses.sa:
एत देवा दक्षिणतः पश्चात् प्राञ्च उदेत ।
पुरस्तादुत्तराच्छक्रा विश्वे देवाः समेत्य ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: eta devā dakṣiṇataḥ paścāt prāñca udeta purastāduttarācchakrā viśve devāḥ sametya te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: Come hither from the south, ye Gods, rise and come forward from the west, i Gathered together, all ye Gods, ye mighty Ones, from east and north: may they deliver us from woe,

verses.sa:
विश्वान् देवानिदं ब्रूमः सत्यसंधानृतावृधः ।
विश्वाभिः पत्नीभिः सह ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: viśvān devānidaṃ brūmaḥ satyasaṃdhānṛtāvṛdhaḥ viśvābhiḥ patnībhiḥ saha te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: This we address to all the Gods, faithful, maintainers of the Right, With all their Consorts by their side: 'may they deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
सर्वान् देवानिदं ब्रूमः सत्यसंधानृतावृधः ।
सर्वाभिः पत्नीभिः सह ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: sarvān devānidaṃ brūmaḥ satyasaṃdhānṛtāvṛdhaḥ sarvābhiḥ patnībhiḥ saha te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: We speak to the collected Gods, faithful, maint siners of the Right, Present with their collective Dames: may these deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
भूतं ब्रूमो भूतपतिं भूतानामुत यो वशी।
भूतानि सर्वा संगत्य ते नो मुञ्चन्त्वंहसः॥
verses.tr: bhūtaṃ brūmo bhūtapatiṃ bhūtānāmuta yo vaśī bhūtāni sarvā saṃgatya te no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ
verses.en: The spirit, yea, the Spirits Lord, ruler of spirits, we address. Together let all spirits meet: may. these deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
या देवीः पञ्च प्रदिशो ये देवा द्वादशर्तवः ।
संवत्सरस्य ये दंष्ट्रास्ते नः सन्तु सदा शिवाः॥
verses.tr: yā devīḥ pañca pradiśo ye devā dvādaśartavaḥ saṃvatsarasya ye daṃṣṭrāste naḥ santu sadā śivāḥ
verses.en: The five Sky regions, Goddesses, and the twelve Seasons which are Gods, "The teeth of the completed year, may these deliver us from woe.

verses.sa:
यन्मातली रथक्रीतममृतं वेद भेषजम्।
तदिन्द्रो अप्सु प्रावेशयत् तदापो दत्त भेषजम्॥
verses.tr: yanmātalī rathakrītamamṛtaṃ veda bheṣajam tadindro apsu prāveśayat tadāpo datta bheṣajam
verses.en: The deathless balm that Matali knows, purchased at a chariots price, Indra effused into the floods. Waters, give us that healing balm!

sections.label: A glorification of the Uchchhishta or Residue of Sacrifice
sections.name: Book 11, hymn 7

verses.en: The Residue of Sacrifice contain eth name, and from, and world: Indra and Agni and the whole universe are comprised therein.
The Residue of Sacrifice holdeth Earth, Heaven, and all that is: The Residue of Sacrifice holdeth sea, waters, Moon, and Wind.
Real, non-real, both are there, Prajapati, and. Death, and strength: Thereon depend the worldly ones: in me are glory Dra: and Vra,
The firm, the fast. the strong; the hard, Brahma, the, All-creating Ten, Gods, as a wheel about the nave, are fixed all round the Residue. a i
Verse, Song, and Sacrificial Text, chanting, the i prelude, and the laud, The hum is in the Residue, the tone, the murmur of the psalm.
Within the Residue, like babes unborn, the parts of sacrifice, $n. Aindregne Pavamana lie, Mahanumni, Mabavrata.
The Vajayeya, Royal Rite, the Agnishtoma and its forms, Hymns, joyfullest with living grass the Asvamedha, "are therein, l
Diksha and Aynyadheya, rite that sates the wish, with magic hymn, Suspended rites, long sessions, are contained within the Residue,
Faith fire-oblation, fervent zeal, service, and sacrificial cry, Guerdon, good works and their reward, are stored within the Residue. E
Sacrifice of one night, or two, Sdyahkri, Ukthya, and Prakri, Call, deep-toned summons are therein, fine parts, through lore, of sacrifice.
I Sacrifice of four nights, of five, of six nights, day and night conjoined, Shodasi, seven-night sacrifice, all these sprang from the Residue, these which the Immortal One con-tans,
Pratihdra and Nidhanam, the Visvajit, the Abhijit, The two Sahnatiratras and the Twelve-day rite are stored therein.
Pleasantness, reverence, peace, and power, strength, Vigour, immortality—All forward wishes are with love satisfied in the Residue.
Nine several oceans, earths, and skies are set within the Residue. Bright shines the Sun therein, in me, the Residue, are Day and Night.
The Residue, the Father's sire, who bears this uni verse, supports Vibhvan, Upahavya, and all worship offered secretly.
The Father's sire, the Residue, grandson. of Spirit, primal Sire, Lord of the universe, the Bull, dwells on the earth victorious,
Right, truth, dominion, fervent zeal, toil, duty, action, future, past, 'Valour,' prosperity, and strength dwell in the Residue in strength,
Welfare, resolve and energy, the six expanses, king ship, sway, Prayer, and direction, and the year, oblation, planets, are therein;
"And the four Hotars, Apri hymns, the N ivids, and, Four-monthly rites, Oblations, sacrifices, 'and animal offerings and their forms,
Months, half-months, sections of the year, seasons, are in the Residue, The waters resonant afer, the thunder, and the mighty noise,
Pebbles, sand; stones, and herbs, and plants, and grass are in the Residue. Closely embraced and laid therein are lightnings and the clouds and rain.
Gain, acquisition, and success, fulness, complete prosperity, Great gain and wealth; are laid, concealed 'aid treasured, in the Residue.
Am things that breathe the breath of life, all creatures that have eyes to see, All the celestial Gods whose home is heaven sprang from the Residue,
Verses, and Songs, and magic hymns, Purana, sacrificial text, All the celestial Gods whose home is heaven sprang from the Residue,
Inbreath and outbreath, eye and ear, decay and f'esdom from decay, All the celestial Gods whose home is heaven sprang. from the Residue.
All pleasure and enjoyments, all delights and rapturous ecstasies. All the celestial Gods whose home is heaven sprang ' from the Residue.
The Deities, the Fathers, men, Gandharvas, and. A apsarases, All the celestial Gods whose home is heaven sprang from the Re idue. Nes Hymn VIII.

sections.label: On the origin of some Gods and the creation of man
sections.name: Book 11, hymn 8

verses.sa:
यन्मन्युर्जायामावहत् संकल्पस्य गृहादधि ।
क आसं जन्याः के वराः क उ ज्येष्ठवरोऽभवत्॥
verses.tr: yanmanyurjāyāmāvahat saṃkalpasya gṛhādadhi ka āsaṃ janyāḥ ke varāḥ ka u jyeṣṭhavaro'bhavat
verses.en: o Wass Manyu brought his consort home forth from Sankalpa's dwelling-place, Who were the wooers of the bride, who was the. chief who courted her?

verses.sa:
तपश्चैवास्तां कर्म चान्तर्महत्यऽर्णवे।
त आसं जन्यास्ते वरा ब्रह्म ज्येष्ठवरोऽभवत्॥
verses.tr: tapaścaivāstāṃ karma cāntarmahatya'rṇave ta āsaṃ janyāste varā brahma jyeṣṭhavaro'bhavat
verses.en: Fervour and Action were the two, in depths of the great billowy sea? These were the wooers of the bride; Brahma the chief who courted her.

verses.sa:
दश साकमजायन्त देवा देवेभ्यः पुरा।
यो वै तान् विद्यात् प्रत्यक्षं स वा अद्य महद् वदेत्॥
verses.tr: daśa sākamajāyanta devā devebhyaḥ purā yo vai tān vidyāt pratyakṣaṃ sa vā adya mahad vadet
verses.en: Ten Gods before the Gods -were born together in the ancient time, Whoso may know them face to face may now pronounce the mighty. word.

verses.sa:
प्राणापानौ चक्षुः श्रोत्रमक्षितिश्च क्षितिश्च या।
व्यानोदानौ वाङ् मनस्ते वा आकूतिमावहन्॥
verses.tr: prāṇāpānau cakṣuḥ śrotramakṣitiśca kṣitiśca yā vyānodānau vāṅ manaste vā ākūtimāvahan
verses.en: Inbreath and outbreath, eye and ear, decay and freedom from decay, - Expiration upward and diffused, voice, mind have brought us wish and plan.

verses.sa:
अजाता आसन्नृतवोऽथो धाता बृहस्पतिः ।
इन्द्राग्नी अश्विना तर्हि कं ते ज्येष्ठमुपासत॥
verses.tr: ajātā āsannṛtavo'tho dhātā bṛhaspatiḥ indrāgnī aśvinā tarhi kaṃ te jyeṣṭhamupāsata
verses.en: As yet the Seasons were unborn, and Dhatar and Prajapati, Both Asvins, Indra, Agni. Whom then did they worship as supreme?

verses.sa:
तपश्चैवास्तां कर्म चान्तर्महत्यर्णवे।
तपो ह जज्ञे कर्मणस्तत् ते ज्येष्ठमुपासत॥
verses.tr: tapaścaivāstāṃ karma cāntarmahatyarṇave tapo ha jajñe karmaṇastat te jyeṣṭhamupāsata
verses.en: Fervour and Action were the two, in depths of the great billowy sea; Fervour sprang up 'from Action: this they served and worshipped as supreme,

verses.sa:
येत आसीद् भूमिः पूर्वा यामद्धातय इद् विदुः ।
यो वै तां विद्यान्नामथा स मन्येत पुराणवित्॥
verses.tr: yeta āsīd bhūmiḥ pūrvā yāmaddhātaya id viduḥ yo vai tāṃ vidyānnāmathā sa manyeta purāṇavit
verses.en: He may account himself well versed in ancient time who knows by name, The earth that was before this earth, which only wisest Sages know. oe Pen E

verses.sa:
कुत इन्द्रः कुतः सोमः कुतो अग्निरजायत ।
कुतस्त्वष्टा समभवत् कुतो धाताजायत॥
verses.tr: kuta indraḥ kutaḥ somaḥ kuto agnirajāyata kutastvaṣṭā samabhavat kuto dhātājāyata
verses.en: From whom did Indra spring? from whom sprang Soma? whence was Agni born? From whom did Tvashtar spring to life? and whence is Dhatar's origin?

verses.sa:
इन्द्रादिन्द्रः सोमात् सोमो अग्नेरग्निरजायत ।
त्वष्टा ह जज्ञे त्वष्टुर्धातुर्धाताजायत॥
verses.tr: indrādindraḥ somāt somo agneragnirajāyata tvaṣṭā ha jajñe tvaṣṭurdhāturdhātājāyata
verses.en: Indra from Indra, Soma from Soma, from Agni Agni sprang. Tvashtar from Tvashtar was produced, Dhatar was Dhatar's origin.

verses.sa:
ये त आसन् दश जाता देवा देवेभ्यः पुरा।
पुत्रेभ्यो लोकं दत्त्वा कस्मिंस्ते लोक आसते॥
verses.tr: ye ta āsan daśa jātā devā devebhyaḥ purā putrebhyo lokaṃ dattvā kasmiṃste loka āsate
verses.en: Those Gods who were of old, the Ten begotten earlier than the Gods, What world do they, inhabit since they gave the world unto their sons?

verses.sa:
यदा केशानस्थि स्नाव मांसं मज्जानमाभरत्।
शरीरं कृत्वा पादवत् कं लोकमनु प्राविशत्॥
verses.tr: yadā keśānasthi snāva māṃsaṃ majjānamābharat śarīraṃ kṛtvā pādavat kaṃ lokamanu prāviśat
verses.en: When he had brought together hair, sinew and bone, marrow and flesh, And to the body added feet, then to what world did he depart?

verses.sa:
कुतः केशान् कुतः स्नाव कुतो अस्थीन्याभरत्।
अङ्गा पर्वाणि मज्जानं को मांसं कुत आभरत्॥
verses.tr: kutaḥ keśān kutaḥ snāva kuto asthīnyābharat aṅgā parvāṇi majjānaṃ ko māṃsaṃ kuta ābharat
verses.en: Whence, from what region did he bring the hair, the sinews, and the bones, Marrow and limbs, and joints, and flesh? Who was the bringer, and from whence?

verses.sa:
संसिचो नाम ते देवा ये संभारान्त्समभरन्।
सर्वं संसिच्य मर्त्यं देवाः पुरुषमाविशन्॥
verses.tr: saṃsico nāma te devā ye saṃbhārāntsamabharan sarvaṃ saṃsicya martyaṃ devāḥ puruṣamāviśan
verses.en: Casters, those Gods were called who brought together all the elements: When they had fused the mortal man' complete, they entered into him.

verses.sa:
ऊरू पादावष्ठीवन्तौ शिरौ हस्तावथो मुखम्।
पृष्टीर्बर्जह्ये पार्श्वे कस्तत् समदधादृषिः॥
verses.tr: ūrū pādāvaṣṭhīvantau śirau hastāvatho mukham pṛṣṭīrbarjahye pārśve kastat samadadhādṛṣiḥ
verses.en: The thighs, the knee-benes, and the feet, the head, the face, and both the hands, The ribs, the nipples, and the sides—what Rishi hath constructed that?

verses.sa:
शिरो हस्तावथो मुखं जिह्वां ग्रीवाश्च कीकसाः ।
त्वचा प्रावृत्य सर्वं तत् संधा समदधान्मही॥
verses.tr: śiro hastāvatho mukhaṃ jihvāṃ grīvāśca kīkasāḥ tvacā prāvṛtya sarvaṃ tat saṃdhā samadadhānmahī
verses.en: Head, both the hands, and face, and tongue, and neck, and intercostal parts, All this, investing it with skins, Mahi conjoined with bond and tie.

verses.sa:
यत् तच्छरीरमशयत् संधया संहितं महत्।
येनेदमद्य रोचते को अस्मिन् वर्णमाभरत्॥
verses.tr: yat taccharīramaśayat saṃdhayā saṃhitaṃ mahat yenedamadya rocate ko asmin varṇamābharat
verses.en: What time the mighty body lay firmly compact with tie and bond, Who gave its colour to the form, the hue wherewith it shines to-day?

verses.sa:
सर्वे देवा उपाशिक्षन् तदजानाद् वधूः सती।
ईशा वशस्य या जाया सास्मिन् वर्णमाभरत्॥
verses.tr: sarve devā upāśikṣan tadajānād vadhūḥ satī īśā vaśasya yā jāyā sāsmin varṇamābharat
verses.en: All Deities had lent their aid: of this a noble Dame took note, Isa, the Consort of Command. She gave its colour to the form.

verses.sa:
यदा त्वष्टा व्यतृणत् पिता त्वष्टुर्य उत्तरः ।
गृहं कृत्वा मर्त्यं देवाः पुरुषमाविशन्॥
verses.tr: yadā tvaṣṭā vyatṛṇat pitā tvaṣṭurya uttaraḥ gṛhaṃ kṛtvā martyaṃ devāḥ puruṣamāviśan
verses.en: When Tvashtar, Tvashtar's loftier Sire, had bored it out and hollowod it, Gods made the mortal their abode, and entered and possessed the man.

verses.sa:
स्वप्नो वै तन्द्रीर्निरृतिः पाप्मानो नाम देवताः ।
जरा खालत्यं पालित्यं शरीरमनु प्राविशन्॥
verses.tr: svapno vai tandrīrnirṛtiḥ pāpmāno nāma devatāḥ jarā khālatyaṃ pālityaṃ śarīramanu prāviśan
verses.en: Sleep, specially, Sloth, Nirriti, and deites whose name is Sin, Baldness, old age, and hoary hairs within the body found their way,

verses.sa:
स्तेयं दुष्कृतं वृजिनं सत्यं यज्ञो यशो बृहत्।
बलं च क्षत्रमोजश्च शरीरमनु प्राविशन्॥
verses.tr: steyaṃ duṣkṛtaṃ vṛjinaṃ satyaṃ yajño yaśo bṛhat balaṃ ca kṣatramojaśca śarīramanu prāviśan
verses.en: Theft, evil-doing, and deceit, truth, sacrifice, exalted fame, Strength, princely power, and energy entered the l body as a home,

verses.sa:
भूतिश्च वा अभूतिश्च रातयोऽरातयश्च याः ।
क्षुधश्च सर्वास्तृष्णाश्च शरीरमनु प्राविशन्॥
verses.tr: bhūtiśca vā abhūtiśca rātayo'rātayaśca yāḥ kṣudhaśca sarvāstṛṣṇāśca śarīramanu prāviśan
verses.en: Prosperity and poverty, kindnesses and malignities, Hunger and thirst of every kind entered the body as a home,

verses.sa:
निन्दाश्च वा अनिन्दाश्च यच्च हन्तेति नेति च ।
शरीरं श्रद्धा दक्षिणाश्रद्धा चानु प्राविशन्॥
verses.tr: nindāśca vā anindāśca yacca hanteti neti ca śarīraṃ śraddhā dakṣiṇāśraddhā cānu prāviśan
verses.en: Reproaches, freedom from reproach, all blamable, all blameless deeds, Bounty, belief, and unbelief entered the body as a home,

verses.sa:
विद्याश्च वा अविद्याश्च यच्चान्यदुपदेश्यऽम्।
शरीरं ब्रह्म प्राविशदृचः सामाथो यजुः॥
verses.tr: vidyāśca vā avidyāśca yaccānyadupadeśya'm śarīraṃ brahma prāviśadṛcaḥ sāmātho yajuḥ
verses.en: All knowledge and all ignorance, each other thing that one may learn, Entered the body, prayer, and hymns, and songs, and sacrificial texts.

verses.sa:
आनन्दा मोदाः प्रमुदोऽभिमोदमुदश्च ये।
हसो नरिष्टा नृत्तानि शरीरमनु प्राविशन्॥
verses.tr: ānandā modāḥ pramudo'bhimodamudaśca ye haso nariṣṭā nṛttāni śarīramanu prāviśan
verses.en: Enjoyments, pleasures, and delights, gladness, and rapturous ecstasies, Laughter and merriment aud dance entered the body as a home.

verses.sa:
आलापाश्च प्रलापाश्चाभिलापलपश्च ये।
शरीरं सर्वे प्राविशन्नायुजः प्रयुजो युजः॥
verses.tr: ālāpāśca pralāpāścābhilāpalapaśca ye śarīraṃ sarve prāviśannāyujaḥ prayujo yujaḥ
verses.en: Discourse and conversation, and the shrill-resounding cries of woe, All entered in, the motives and the purposes combined therewith,

verses.sa:
प्राणापानौ चक्षुः श्रोत्रमक्षितिश्च क्षितिश्च या।
व्यानोदानौ वाङ् मनः शरीरेण त ईयन्ते॥
verses.tr: prāṇāpānau cakṣuḥ śrotramakṣitiśca kṣitiśca yā vyānodānau vāṅ manaḥ śarīreṇa ta īyante
verses.en: Inbreath and outbreath, ear and eye, decay and freedom from decay, Breath upward and diffused, voice, mind, these quickly with the body move.

verses.sa:
आशिषश्च प्रशिषश्च संशिषो विशिषश्च याः ।
चित्तानि सर्वे संकल्पाः शरीरमनु प्राविशन्॥
verses.tr: āśiṣaśca praśiṣaśca saṃśiṣo viśiṣaśca yāḥ cittāni sarve saṃkalpāḥ śarīramanu prāviśan
verses.en: All earnest wishes, all commands, directions, and admonishments, Reflections, all deliberate plans entered the body as a home,

verses.sa:
आस्तेयीश्च वास्तेयीश्च त्वरणाः कृपणाश्च याः ।
गुह्याः शुक्रा स्थूला अपस्ता बीभत्सावसादयन्॥
verses.tr: āsteyīśca vāsteyīśca tvaraṇāḥ kṛpaṇāśca yāḥ guhyāḥ śukrā sthūlā apastā bībhatsāvasādayan
verses.en: They laid inthe abhorrent frame those waters hidden, bright, and thick, Which in the bowels spring from blood, from mourning or from hasty toil,

verses.sa:
अस्थि कृत्वा समिधं तदष्टापो असादयन्।
रेतः कृत्वाज्यं देवाः पुरुषमाविशन्॥
verses.tr: asthi kṛtvā samidhaṃ tadaṣṭāpo asādayan retaḥ kṛtvājyaṃ devāḥ puruṣamāviśan
verses.en: Fuel they turned to bone, and then they set light waters in the frame. The molten butter they made seed: then the Gods entered into man,

verses.sa:
या आपो याश्च देवता या विराड् ब्रह्मणा सह।
शरीरं ब्रह्म प्राविशच्छरीरेऽधि प्रजापतिः॥
verses.tr: yā āpo yāśca devatā yā virāḍ brahmaṇā saha śarīraṃ brahma prāviśaccharīre'dhi prajāpatiḥ
verses.en: All Waters, all the Deities, Viraj with Brahma at her side: Brahma into the body passed: Prajapati i is Lord thereof,

verses.sa:
सूर्यश्चक्षुर्वातः प्राणं पुरुषस्य वि भेजिरे ।
अथास्येतरमात्मानं देवाः प्रायच्छन्नग्नये॥
verses.tr: sūryaścakṣurvātaḥ prāṇaṃ puruṣasya vi bhejire athāsyetaramātmānaṃ devāḥ prāyacchannagnaye
verses.en: The Sun and Wind formed, separate, the eye and vital breath of man. His other person have the Gods bestowed on Agni as a gift,

verses.sa:
तस्माद् वै विद्वान् पुरुषमिदं ब्रह्मेति मन्यते ।
सर्वा ह्यऽस्मिन् देवता गावो गोष्ठ इवासते॥
verses.tr: tasmād vai vidvān puruṣamidaṃ brahmeti manyate sarvā hya'smin devatā gāvo goṣṭha ivāsate
verses.en: Therefore whoever knoweth man regardeth him as Brahman's self: For all the Deities abide in him as cattle in their pen.

verses.sa:
प्रथमेन प्रमारेण त्रेधा विष्वङ् वि गच्छति ।
अद एकेन गच्छत्यद एकेन गच्छतीहैकेन नि षेवते॥
verses.tr: prathamena pramāreṇa tredhā viṣvaṅ vi gacchati ada ekena gacchatyada ekena gacchatīhaikena ni ṣevate
verses.en: At his first death he goeth hence, asunder, in three separate parts. "He goeth yonder with one part, with one he goeth. yonder: here he sinketh downward with a third,

verses.sa:
अप्सु स्तीमासु वृद्धासु शरीरमन्तरा हितम्।
तस्मिंछवोऽध्यन्तरा तस्माच्छवोऽध्युच्यते॥
verses.tr: apsu stīmāsu vṛddhāsu śarīramantarā hitam tasmiṃchavo'dhyantarā tasmācchavo'dhyucyate
verses.en: In the primeval waters cold the body is deposited, In this there is the power of growth: from this is power of growth declared,

sections.label: An incantation for the destruction of a hostile army
sections.name: Book 11, hymn 9

verses.sa:
ये बाहवो या इषवो धन्वनां वीर्याऽणि च ।
असीन् परशूनायुधं चित्ताकूतं च यद्धृदि ।
सर्वं तदर्बुदे त्वममित्रेभ्यो दृशे कुरूदारांश्च प्र दर्शय॥
verses.tr: ye bāhavo yā iṣavo dhanvanāṃ vīryā'ṇi ca asīn paraśūnāyudhaṃ cittākūtaṃ ca yaddhṛdi sarvaṃ tadarbude tvamamitrebhyo dṛśe kurūdārāṃśca pra darśaya
verses.en: All arms and every arrow, all the power and might that bows possess, The warlike weapon, axes, swords, the plan and purpose in the heart, All this, O Arbudi, make thou visible to our enemies, and let them look' on mist and fog.

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठत सं नह्यध्वं मित्रा देवजना यूयम्।
संदृष्टा गुप्ता वः सन्तु या नो मित्राण्यर्बुदे॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭhata saṃ nahyadhvaṃ mitrā devajanā yūyam saṃdṛṣṭā guptā vaḥ santu yā no mitrāṇyarbude
verses.en: Arise ye and prepare yourselves: ye, the celestial hosts, are friends, Let your mysterious natures be seen by our friends O Arbudi.

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठतमा रभेतामादानसंदानाभ्याम्।
अमित्राणां सेना अभि धत्तमर्बुदे॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭhatamā rabhetāmādānasaṃdānābhyām amitrāṇāṃ senā abhi dhattamarbude
verses.en: Rise both of you: begin your work with fettering and binding fast, Assail, both of you, Arbudi, the armies of our enemies.

verses.sa:
अर्बुदिर्नाम यो देव ईशानश्च न्यऽर्बुदिः ।
याभ्यामन्तरिक्षमावृतमियं च पृथिवी मही।
ताभ्यामिन्द्रमेदिभ्यामहं जितमन्वेमि सेनया॥
verses.tr: arbudirnāma yo deva īśānaśca nya'rbudiḥ yābhyāmantarikṣamāvṛtamiyaṃ ca pṛthivī mahī tābhyāmindramedibhyāmahaṃ jitamanvemi senayā
verses.en: The God whose name is Arbudi, and Nyarbudi the Mighty One, The two by whom the air and this great earth are compassed and possessed, With these two friends of Indra I go forth to conquer with the host,

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठ त्वं देवजनार्बुदे सेनया सह।
भञ्जन्नमित्राणां सेनां भोगेभिः परि वारय॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭha tvaṃ devajanārbude senayā saha bhañjannamitrāṇāṃ senāṃ bhogebhiḥ pari vāraya
verses.en: Rise, with our army stand thou up, O Godlike Being; Arbudi. Breaking the hosts of enemies, surround them with thy winding coils,

verses.sa:
सप्त जातान् न्यऽर्बुद उदाराणां समीक्षयन्।
तेभिष्ट्वमाज्ये हुते सर्वैरुत्तिष्ठ सेनया॥
verses.tr: sapta jātān nya'rbuda udārāṇāṃ samīkṣayan tebhiṣṭvamājye hute sarvairuttiṣṭha senayā
verses.en: Exhibiting, O Arbudi, seven children of the mist and fog, When butter hath been offered, rise' with all of these and with the host.

verses.sa:
प्रतिघ्नानाश्रुमुखी कृधुकर्णी च क्रोशतु ।
विकेशी पुरुषे हते रदिते अर्बुदे तव॥
verses.tr: pratighnānāśrumukhī kṛdhukarṇī ca krośatu vikeśī puruṣe hate radite arbude tava
verses.en: Beating her breast, with tearful face, let the short-eared, the wild-haired hag Shriek loudly when a man is slain, pierced through by thee, O Arbudi;

verses.sa:
संकर्षन्ती करूकरं मनसा पुत्रमिच्छन्ती ।
पतिं भ्रातरमात्स्वान् रदिते अर्बुदे तव॥
verses.tr: saṃkarṣantī karūkaraṃ manasā putramicchantī patiṃ bhrātaramātsvān radite arbude tava
verses.en: Snatching away the vertebra, while with her thought 'she seeks her son, Her husband, brother, kin, when one, Arbudi! hath been pierced by thee,

verses.sa:
अलिक्लवा जाष्कमदा गृध्राः श्येनाः पतत्रिणः ।
ध्वाङ्क्षाः शकुनयस्तृप्यन्त्वमित्रेषु समीक्षयन् रदिते अर्बुदे तव॥
verses.tr: aliklavā jāṣkamadā gṛdhrāḥ śyenāḥ patatriṇaḥ dhvāṅkṣāḥ śakunayastṛpyantvamitreṣu samīkṣayan radite arbude tava
verses.en: Let vultures, ravens, kites, and crows, and every carrion-eating bird. Feast on our foes, and show where one, Arbudi! hath. been pierced by thee.

verses.sa:
अथो सर्वं श्वापदं मक्षिका तृप्यतु क्रिमिः ।
पौरुषेयेऽधि कुणपे रदिते अर्बुदे तव॥
verses.tr: atho sarvaṃ śvāpadaṃ makṣikā tṛpyatu krimiḥ pauruṣeye'dhi kuṇape radite arbude tava
verses.en: Then let each greedy beast of prey, and fly and worm. regale itself Upon the human corpse where one, Arbudi, hath been pierced by thee,

verses.sa:
आ गृह्णीतं सं बृहतं प्रानापानान् न्यर्बुदे ।
निवाशा घोषाः सं यन्त्वमित्रेषु समीक्षयन् रदिते अर्बुदे तव॥
verses.tr: ā gṛhṇītaṃ saṃ bṛhataṃ prānāpānān nyarbude nivāśā ghoṣāḥ saṃ yantvamitreṣu samīkṣayan radite arbude tava
verses.en: Attack them, both of you; bear off their vital breath, O Nyarbudi, i Let mingled shouts and echoing cries of woe amid our foemen show where thou, O' Arbudi, hast pierced.

verses.sa:
उद् वेपय सं विजन्तां भियामित्रान्त्सं सृज ।
उरुग्राहैर्बाह्वङ्कैर्विध्यामित्रान् न्यर्बुदे॥
verses.tr: ud vepaya saṃ vijantāṃ bhiyāmitrāntsaṃ sṛja urugrāhairbāhvaṅkairvidhyāmitrān nyarbude
verses.en: Shake them, and let them sink with fear: o'erwhelm our enemies with dread. With widely-grasping bends of arm, O Arbudi, crush down our foes.

verses.sa:
मुह्यन्त्वेषां बाहवश्चित्ताकूतं च यद्धृदि।
मैषामुच्छेषि किं चन रदिते अर्बुदे तव॥
verses.tr: muhyantveṣāṃ bāhavaścittākūtaṃ ca yaddhṛdi maiṣāmuccheṣi kiṃ cana radite arbude tava
verses.en: Let those mens' arms grow faint and weak, dull be the purpose of their heart; And let not aught of them be left when thou, O Arbudi, hast pierced.

verses.sa:
प्रतिघ्नानाः सं धावन्तूरः पटूरावाघ्नानाः ।
अघारिणीर्विकेश्योऽ रुदत्यः१ पुरुषे हते रदिते अर्बुदे तव॥
verses.tr: pratighnānāḥ saṃ dhāvantūraḥ paṭūrāvāghnānāḥ aghāriṇīrvikeśyo' rudatyaḥ1 puruṣe hate radite arbude tava
verses.en: Self-smiting, beating breast and thigh, careless of unguent, with their hair dishevelled, weeping, hags shall run together, when a man is slain, when thou, O Arbudi, hast pierced.

verses.sa:
श्वऽन्वतीरप्सरसो रूपका उतार्बुदे ।
अन्तःपात्रे रेरिहतीं रिशां दुर्णिहितैषिणीम्।
सर्वास्ता अर्बुदे त्वममित्रेभ्यो दृशे कुरूदारांश्च प्र दर्शय॥
verses.tr: śva'nvatīrapsaraso rūpakā utārbude antaḥpātre rerihatīṃ riśāṃ durṇihitaiṣiṇīm sarvāstā arbude tvamamitrebhyo dṛśe kurūdārāṃśca pra darśaya
verses.en: Apsarases with dog-like mates, and Rusamas, O Arbudi, And her who licks the cup inside, and seeks to wound in ill-kept place, All these, O Arbudi, do thou make visible to our enemies, and let them look on mists and fog.

verses.sa:
खडूरेऽधिचङ्क्रमां खर्विकां खर्ववासिनीम्।
य उदारा अन्तर्हिता गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च ये ।
सर्पा इतरजना रक्षांसि॥
verses.tr: khaḍūre'dhicaṅkramāṃ kharvikāṃ kharvavāsinīm ya udārā antarhitā gandharvāpsarasaśca ye sarpā itarajanā rakṣāṃsi
verses.en: The fiend who creeps upon the sword, maimed, dwelling where the wounded lie, The misty shapes that lurk concealed, Gandharvas and Apsarases, demons, and snakes, and Other Folk;

verses.sa:
चतुर्दंष्ट्रांछ्यावदतः कुम्भमुष्काँ असृङ्मुखान्।
स्वभ्यसा ये चोद्भ्यसाः॥
verses.tr: caturdaṃṣṭrāṃchyāvadataḥ kumbhamuṣkāṃ asṛṅmukhān svabhyasā ye codbhyasāḥ
verses.en: Armed with four fangs and yellow teeth, deformed, with faces smeared with blood, the terrible and fearless ones,

verses.sa:
उद् वेपय त्वमर्बुदेऽमित्राणाममूः सिचः ।
जयांश्च जिष्णुश्चामित्रां जयतामिन्द्रमेदिनौ॥
verses.tr: ud vepaya tvamarbude'mitrāṇāmamūḥ sicaḥ jayāṃśca jiṣṇuścāmitrāṃ jayatāmindramedinau
verses.en: Make thou, O Arbudi, those wings of hostile armies quake with dread. Let Conqueror and Victor, friends of Indra, overcome our foes,

verses.sa:
प्रब्लीनो मृदितः शयां हतो३मित्रो न्यर्बुदे ।
अग्निजिह्वा धूमशिखा जयन्तीर्यन्तु सेनया॥
verses.tr: prablīno mṛditaḥ śayāṃ hato3mitro nyarbude agnijihvā dhūmaśikhā jayantīryantu senayā
verses.en: Stifled and crushed, O Nyarbudi, low let the smitten foeman lie. With tongue of fire and crest of smoke go conquering maidens with our host!

verses.sa:
तयार्बुदे प्रणुत्तानामिन्द्रो हन्तु वरंवरम्।
अमित्राणां शचीपतिर्मामीषां मोचि कश्चन॥
verses.tr: tayārbude praṇuttānāmindro hantu varaṃvaram amitrāṇāṃ śacīpatirmāmīṣāṃ moci kaścana
verses.en: May Indra, Lord of Might, strike down each bravest warrior of the foes, Whom this our band hath put to flight: let not one man of those escape.

verses.sa:
उत्कसन्तु हृदयान्यूर्ध्वः प्राण उदीषतु ।
शौष्कास्यमनु वर्तताममित्रान्मोत मित्रिणः॥
verses.tr: utkasantu hṛdayānyūrdhvaḥ prāṇa udīṣatu śauṣkāsyamanu vartatāmamitrānmota mitriṇaḥ
verses.en: Let their hearts burst asunder, let their breath fly up and pass away. Let dryness of the mouth o'ertake our foemen, nob the friendly ones.

verses.sa:
ये च धीरा ये चाधीराः पराञ्चो बधिराश्च ये।
तमसा ये च तूपरा अथो बस्ताभिवासिनः ।
सर्वांस्ताँ अर्बुदे त्वममित्रेभ्यो दृशे कुरूदारांश्च प्रदर्शय॥
verses.tr: ye ca dhīrā ye cādhīrāḥ parāñco badhirāśca ye tamasā ye ca tūparā atho bastābhivāsinaḥ sarvāṃstāṃ arbude tvamamitrebhyo dṛśe kurūdārāṃśca pradarśaya
verses.en: The clever and the foolish ones, those who are twisted round, the deaf, The dusky-hued, the hornless goats, and those whose voice is like the buck's, All these, O Arbudi, do thou make visible to our enemies: cause them to look on mists and fog.

verses.sa:
अर्बुदिश्च त्रिषंधिश्चामित्रान् नो वि विध्यताम्।
यथैषामिन्द्र वृत्रहन् हनाम शचीपतेऽमित्राणां सहस्रशः॥
verses.tr: arbudiśca triṣaṃdhiścāmitrān no vi vidhyatām yathaiṣāmindra vṛtrahan hanāma śacīpate'mitrāṇāṃ sahasraśaḥ
verses.en: Arbudi and Trishandhi fall upon our foes and scatter them, So that, O Indra, Lord of Might, Slayer of Vritra, we may kill thousands of these our enemies!

verses.sa:
वनस्पतीन् वानस्पत्यानोषधीरुत वीरुधः ।
गन्धर्वाप्सरसः सर्पान् देवान् पुण्यजनान् पितॄन्।
सर्वांस्तां अर्बुदे त्वममित्रेभ्यो दृशे कुरूदारांश्च प्र दर्शय॥
verses.tr: vanaspatīn vānaspatyānoṣadhīruta vīrudhaḥ gandharvāpsarasaḥ sarpān devān puṇyajanān pitṝn sarvāṃstāṃ arbude tvamamitrebhyo dṛśe kurūdārāṃśca pra darśaya
verses.en: Tall trees, and those who live in woods, the herbs and creeping plants of Earth, Gandharvas, and Apsarases, Snakes, Holy Beings, Fathers, Gods, All these do thou, O Arbudi, make visible to our enemies: cause them to look on mists and fog.

verses.sa:
ईशां वो मरुतो देव आदित्यो ब्रह्मणस्पतिः ।
ईशां व इन्द्रश्चाग्निश्च धाता मित्रः प्रजापतिः ।
ईशां व ऋषयश्चक्रुरमित्रेषु समीक्षयन् रदिते अर्बुदे तव॥
verses.tr: īśāṃ vo maruto deva ādityo brahmaṇaspatiḥ īśāṃ va indraścāgniśca dhātā mitraḥ prajāpatiḥ īśāṃ va ṛṣayaścakruramitreṣu samīkṣayan radite arbude tava
verses.en: High sway have Maruts, and the God Aditya, Brahmanaspati, High sway have Indra, Agni, and Dhatar, Mitra, Prajapati, High sway have Rishis given to you, showing upon our enemies where thou, O Arbudi, hast pierced,

verses.sa:
तेषां सर्वेषामीशाना उत् तिष्ठत सं नह्यध्वं मित्रा देवजना यूयम्।
इमं संग्रामं संजित्य यथालोकं वि तिष्ठध्वम्॥
verses.tr: teṣāṃ sarveṣāmīśānā ut tiṣṭhata saṃ nahyadhvaṃ mitrā devajanā yūyam imaṃ saṃgrāmaṃ saṃjitya yathālokaṃ vi tiṣṭhadhvam
verses.en: With full dominion over these, rise, stand ye up, prepare yourselves, Ye are our friends, celestial hosts. When ye have won this- battle, go, each to his several sphere, apart, i E

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठत सं नह्यध्वमुदाराः केतुभिः सह।
सर्पा इतरजना रक्षांस्यमित्राननु धावत॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭhata saṃ nahyadhvamudārāḥ ketubhiḥ saha sarpā itarajanā rakṣāṃsyamitrānanu dhāvata
verses.en: Risk up, with all your banners rise; prepare your strength, ye vapoury Forms! Serpents and fiends and Other Folk, charge and pursue our enemies!

verses.sa:
ईशां वो वेद राज्यं त्रिषंधे अरुणैः केतुभिः सह।
ये अन्तरिक्षे ये दिवि पृथिव्यां ये च मानवाः।
त्रिषंधेस्ते चेतसि दुर्णामान उपासताम्॥
verses.tr: īśāṃ vo veda rājyaṃ triṣaṃdhe aruṇaiḥ ketubhiḥ saha ye antarikṣe ye divi pṛthivyāṃ ye ca mānavāḥ triṣaṃdheste cetasi durṇāmāna upāsatām
verses.en: Let those who bear an evil name, in air, in heaven, on earth, and men, After Trishandhi's will, revere your power, the sway that Knowledge gives, together with your ruddy flags. i

verses.sa:
अयोमुखाः सूचीमुखा अथो विकङ्कतीमुखाः ।
क्रव्यादो वातरंहसः आ सजन्त्वमित्रान् वज्रेण त्रिषंधिना॥
verses.tr: ayomukhāḥ sūcīmukhā atho vikaṅkatīmukhāḥ kravyādo vātaraṃhasaḥ ā sajantvamitrān vajreṇa triṣaṃdhinā
verses.en: Let those with iron faces, with faces like needles or like combs, Flesh-eaters, rapid as the wind, cling closely to our foemen with Trishandhi for their thunderbolt,

verses.sa:
अन्तर्धेहि जातवेद आदित्य कुणपं बहु।
त्रिषंधेरियं सेना सुहितास्तु मे वशे॥
verses.tr: antardhehi jātaveda āditya kuṇapaṃ bahu triṣaṃdheriyaṃ senā suhitāstu me vaśe
verses.en: Omniscient Aditya, make full many a corpse to disappear. Let this devoted army of Trisbandhi be in my control.

verses.sa:
उत् तिष्ठ त्वं देवजनार्बुदे सेनया सह।
अयं बलिर्व आहुतस्त्रिषंधेराहुतिः प्रिया॥
verses.tr: ut tiṣṭha tvaṃ devajanārbude senayā saha ayaṃ balirva āhutastriṣaṃdherāhutiḥ priyā
verses.en: Rise up, O Godlike Being, rise, Arbudi, with thine army: this, i Tribute is sacrificed to thee, Trishandhi's welcome offering.

verses.sa:
शितिपदी सं द्यतु शरव्ये३यं चतुष्पदी ।
कृत्येऽमित्रेभ्यो भव त्रिषंधेः सह सेनया॥
verses.tr: śitipadī saṃ dyatu śaravye3yaṃ catuṣpadī kṛtye'mitrebhyo bhava triṣaṃdheḥ saha senayā
verses.en: May this four-footed White-foot, may this arrow. brace and bind thee fast: Together with Trishandhi's host, be thou, O Witchcraft, meant for foes.

verses.sa:
धूमाक्षी सं पततु कृधुकर्णी च क्रोशतु ।
त्रिषंधेः सेनया जिते अरुणाः सन्तु केतवः॥
verses.tr: dhūmākṣī saṃ patatu kṛdhukarṇī ca krośatu triṣaṃdheḥ senayā jite aruṇāḥ santu ketavaḥ
verses.en: Down let the dim-eyed demon fly, and let her short-eared sister shriek: Red be the banners when the host of Arbudi hath won the day.

verses.sa:
अवायन्तां पक्षिणो ये वयांस्यन्तरिक्षे दिवि ये चरन्ति ।
श्वापदो मक्षिकाः सं रभन्तामामादो गृध्राः कुणपे रदन्ताम्॥
verses.tr: avāyantāṃ pakṣiṇo ye vayāṃsyantarikṣe divi ye caranti śvāpado makṣikāḥ saṃ rabhantāmāmādo gṛdhrāḥ kuṇape radantām
verses.en: Let all the birds that move on wings come downward, all fowls that roam the heavens and air's mid-region, Let beasts of prey and flies attack, and vultures that eat raw flesh mangle and gnaw the carcase,

verses.sa:
यामिन्द्रेण संधां समधत्था ब्रह्मणा च बृहस्पते ।
तयाहमिन्द्रसंधया सर्वान् देवानिह हुव इतो जयत मामुतः॥
verses.tr: yāmindreṇa saṃdhāṃ samadhatthā brahmaṇā ca bṛhaspate tayāhamindrasaṃdhayā sarvān devāniha huva ito jayata māmutaḥ
verses.en: By that same binding treaty which thou madest, Brihaspati! with Indra! and with Brahma, By Indra's pledge I bid the Gods come hither, Conquer on this side, not on their side yonder,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिराङ्गिरस ऋषयो ब्रह्मसंशिताः ।
असुरक्षयणं वधं त्रिषंधिं दिव्याश्रयन्॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirāṅgirasa ṛṣayo brahmasaṃśitāḥ asurakṣayaṇaṃ vadhaṃ triṣaṃdhiṃ divyāśrayan
verses.en: Brihaspati Angirasa, Rishis made strong and keen by prayer Have set Triehandhi in the heaven, dire weapon that destroys the fiends.

verses.sa:
येनासौ गुप्त आदित्य उभाविन्द्रश्च तिष्ठतः।
त्रिषंधि देवा अभजन्तौजसे च बलाय च॥
verses.tr: yenāsau gupta āditya ubhāvindraśca tiṣṭhataḥ triṣaṃdhi devā abhajantaujase ca balāya ca
verses.en: The Gods enjoyed Trishandhi for the sake of energy and power, Him uuder whose protection, both, Indra and yon Aditya, stand,

verses.sa:
सर्वांल्लोकान्त्समजयन् देवा आहुत्यानया ।
बृहस्पतिराङ्गिरसो वज्रं यमसिञ्चतासुरक्षयणं वधम्॥
verses.tr: sarvāṃllokāntsamajayan devā āhutyānayā bṛhaspatirāṅgiraso vajraṃ yamasiñcatāsurakṣayaṇaṃ vadham
verses.en: The Gods, victorious, won themselves all worlds by this oblation, which Brihaspati Angirasa effused, a very thunderbolt, a weapon to destroy the fiends,

verses.sa:
बृहस्पतिराङ्गिरसो वज्रं यमसिञ्चतासुरक्षयणं वधम्।
तेनाहममूं सेनां नि लिम्पामि बृहस्पतेऽमित्रान् हन्म्योजसा॥
verses.tr: bṛhaspatirāṅgiraso vajraṃ yamasiñcatāsurakṣayaṇaṃ vadham tenāhamamūṃ senāṃ ni limpāmi bṛhaspate'mitrān hanmyojasā
verses.en: That fiend-destroying weapon which Brihaspati Angirasa poured out and made a thunderbolt. Even therewith, Brihaspati, I brush that hostile armament, and strike the foemen down with might.

verses.sa:
सर्वे देवा अत्यायन्ति ये अश्नन्ति वषट् कृतम् ।
इमां जुषध्वमाहुतिमितो जयत मामुतः॥
verses.tr: sarve devā atyāyanti ye aśnanti vaṣaṭ kṛtam imāṃ juṣadhvamāhutimito jayata māmutaḥ
verses.en: Over to us come all the Gods who eat the hallowed sacrifice. With this oblation be ye pleased: conquer on this side, not on that.

verses.sa:
सर्वे देवा अत्यायन्तु त्रिषन्धेराहुतिः प्रिया।
संधां महतीं रक्षत ययाग्रे असुरा जिताः॥
verses.tr: sarve devā atyāyantu triṣandherāhutiḥ priyā saṃdhāṃ mahatīṃ rakṣata yayāgre asurā jitāḥ
verses.en: Over to us let all Gods come: dear is Trishandhi's offering, Keep the great pledge through which, of old, the Asuras were overthrown.

verses.sa:
वायुरमित्राणामिष्वग्राण्याञ्चतु ।
इन्द्र एषां बाहून् प्रति भनक्तु मा शकन् प्रतिधामिषुम्।
आदित्य एषामस्त्रं वि नाशयतु चन्द्रमा युतामगतस्य पन्थाम्॥
verses.tr: vāyuramitrāṇāmiṣvagrāṇyāñcatu indra eṣāṃ bāhūn prati bhanaktu mā śakan pratidhāmiṣum āditya eṣāmastraṃ vi nāśayatu candramā yutāmagatasya panthām
verses.en: Let Vayu bend the arrow-points of those who are our enemies, Let Indra break their arms away: no power to lay the shaft be theirs! Aditya utterly destroy their missile! Chandramas bar the path of him who lingers!

verses.sa:
यदि प्रेयुर्देवपुरा ब्रह्म वर्माणि चक्रिरे।
तनूपानं परिपाणं कृण्वाना यदुपोचिरे सर्वं तदरसं कृधि॥
verses.tr: yadi preyurdevapurā brahma varmāṇi cakrire tanūpānaṃ paripāṇaṃ kṛṇvānā yadupocire sarvaṃ tadarasaṃ kṛdhi
verses.en: If they have issued forth strongholds of Gods, and made their shields of prayer, Gaining protection for their lives, protection round about, make all their instigation powerless,

verses.sa:
क्रव्यादानुवर्तयन्मृत्युना च पुरोहितम्।
त्रिषन्धे प्रेहि सेनया जयामित्रान् प्र पद्यस्व॥
verses.tr: kravyādānuvartayanmṛtyunā ca purohitam triṣandhe prehi senayā jayāmitrān pra padyasva
verses.en: With the Flesh-enter and with Death, following the Purohita, On! forward with Trishandhi's host! conquering enemies advance!

verses.sa:
त्रिषन्धे तमसा त्वममित्रान् परि वारय ।
पृषदाज्यप्रणुत्तानां मामीषां मोचि कश्चन॥
verses.tr: triṣandhe tamasā tvamamitrān pari vāraya pṛṣadājyapraṇuttānāṃ māmīṣāṃ moci kaścana
verses.en: Do thou, Trishandhi, with the gloom of darkness compass round our foes; Let none escape of them expelled with speckled butter mixt with curds.

verses.sa:
शितिपदी सं पतत्वमित्राणाममूः सिचः ।
मुह्यन्त्वद्यामूः सेनाः अमित्रानां न्यर्बुदे॥
verses.tr: śitipadī saṃ patatvamitrāṇāmamūḥ sicaḥ muhyantvadyāmūḥ senāḥ amitrānāṃ nyarbude
verses.en: Let White-foot fall upon those wings: of our opponents' armament; Mazed and bewildered he those hands of foes this day, O Nyarbudi.

verses.sa:
मूढा अमित्रा न्यर्बुदे जह्येऽषां वरंवरम्।
अनया जहि सेनया॥
verses.tr: mūḍhā amitrā nyarbude jahye'ṣāṃ varaṃvaram anayā jahi senayā
verses.en: Mazed are the foemen, Nyarbudi! Slay thou each bravest man of them: with this our army slaughter them,

verses.sa:
यश्च कवची यश्चाकवचो३मित्रो यश्चाज्मनि ।
ज्यापाशैः कवचपाशैरज्मनाभिहतः शयाम्॥
verses.tr: yaśca kavacī yaścākavaco3mitro yaścājmani jyāpāśaiḥ kavacapāśairajmanābhihataḥ śayām
verses.en: Low lie the warrior, mailed, unmailed, each foeman in the rush of war, Down-smitten with the strings of bows, the fastenings of mail, the charge!

verses.sa:
ये वर्मिणो येऽवर्माणो अमित्रा ये च वर्मिणः ।
सर्वांस्तां अर्बुदे हतांछ्वानोऽदन्तु भूम्याम्॥
verses.tr: ye varmiṇo ye'varmāṇo amitrā ye ca varmiṇaḥ sarvāṃstāṃ arbude hatāṃchvāno'dantu bhūmyām
verses.en: The armour-clad, the armourless. enemies clothed with coats of mail, All these struck down, O Arbudi, let dogs devour upon the earth,

verses.sa:
ये रथिनो ये अरथा असादा ये च सादिनः ।
सर्वानदन्तु तान् हतान् गृध्राः श्येनाः पतत्रिणः॥
verses.tr: ye rathino ye arathā asādā ye ca sādinaḥ sarvānadantu tān hatān gṛdhrāḥ śyenāḥ patatriṇaḥ
verses.en: Car-borne and carless fighting men, riders and those who go on foot, All these, struck down, let vultures, kites, and all the birds of air devour,

verses.sa:
सहस्रकुणपा शेतामामित्री सेना समरे वधानाम्।
विविद्धा ककजाकृता॥
verses.tr: sahasrakuṇapā śetāmāmitrī senā samare vadhānām vividdhā kakajākṛtā
verses.en: Low let the hostile army lie, thousands of corpses, on the ground, Pierced through and rent to pieces where the deadly weapons clash in fight,

verses.sa:
मर्माविधं रोरुवतं सुपर्णैरदन्तु दुश्चितं मृदितं शयानम्।
य इमां प्रतीचीमाहुतिममित्रो नो युयुत्सति॥
verses.tr: marmāvidhaṃ roruvataṃ suparṇairadantu duścitaṃ mṛditaṃ śayānam ya imāṃ pratīcīmāhutimamitro no yuyutsati
verses.en: With eagles let them eat the evil-hearted, pierced in the vitals, lying crushed and howling, The foe whoe'er will fight against this our protecting sacrifice,

verses.sa:
यां देवा अनुतिस्ठन्ति यस्या नास्ति विराधनम्।
तयेन्द्रो हन्तु वृत्रहा वज्रेण त्रिषंधिना॥
verses.tr: yāṃ devā anutisṭhanti yasyā nāsti virādhanam tayendro hantu vṛtrahā vajreṇa triṣaṃdhinā
verses.en: With this which Gods attend, with this which never fails to gain its end, Let Indra, Vritra-slayer, smite, and with Trishandhi as a bolt.
